entries.zh: 念；凭记忆诵念、背诵（如念经、念书）
entries.en: to recite from memory; to say by heart

entries.zh: 记性；记忆力
entries.en: memory; the faculty of remembering

entries.zh: 记持；记住、记忆（闽南语『记持』）
entries.en: to remember; to keep in memory

entries.zh: 记带；持记随身、牢记不忘（谓记忆固定不迁）
entries.en: fixed, unchanging memory; to keep firmly in mind

entries.zh: 记定；记牢、铭记不移
entries.en: tenacious, settled memory; fixed firmly in the mind

entries.zh: 奏本；官员呈奏皇帝或官府的奏章、本章
entries.en: memorial (official document) submitted by a mandarin to the throne

entries.zh: 降书；投降书、归降文表（一说呈于长上之降帖）
entries.en: letter of surrender; memorial of submission presented to a superior
entries.notes: 西文 memorial del superior 与降书（音写 hâng-tsù，主降伏义）以『呈于长上之降表』解方得对合，两解并存

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头 mendigar＝乞讨、讨乞，注明义同 pedir（参见条）；原稿汉字、闽南音、官话音三栏皆空
entries.en: 〔manuscript defective, gloss uncertain〕 to beg, to ask alms (cross-reference: same as 'pedir'); Chinese/Hokkien/Mandarin columns blank in the manuscript
entries.notes: 四栏仅存西语参见词头 'Mendigar. q. pedir.'（q.＝que），其余三栏空缺，中文释义为据西语补拟故降级

entries.zh: 摇；摇动、挥动
entries.en: to shake; to wave (same as 'mover')
entries.notes: 汉字栏作搔而标 [疑:搖]，音写 iaū/yō 合于搖，故按摇动释义

entries.zh: 动；动弹、移动
entries.en: to move; to stir
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏多形杂陈且含 mǔnasre 等难解形，据汉字動与西文 menear 定义

entries.zh: 摆手；手如衣袖般挥摆
entries.en: to wave or swing the hand loosely, like a sleeve
entries.notes: 汉字託、音写 tô 与西释义『摆手如袖』对合不明，释义依西文描述

entries.zh: 习；（鸟）急速鼓翅、频频试飞（《说文》：习，数飞也）
entries.en: to flap the wings quickly; to keep fluttering the wings

entries.zh: 露；露身、裸露（谓男子露体）
entries.en: to expose oneself (of a man); to bare oneself
entries.notes: 西文 'hombre en mudo' 疑有讹（或 desnudo 之误），据汉字露、音写 lǒu 及下条露体定为露身义

entries.zh: 露体；裸露身体、赤身露体
entries.en: to expose one's body; to be naked

entries.zh: 身体；身躯、躯体
entries.en: body; the human body

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西文谓『在椅上挪移』，fanda 疑为 falda 之讹；汉字作病而标 [疑:著/箸]，音写 pē guîo 对合不明）
entries.en: 〔manuscript defective, gloss uncertain〕 Spanish suggests 'to shift oneself on the chair'; 'fanda' perhaps for 'falda'
entries.notes: 西文 'fanda' 词语讹乱、汉字病带 [疑:著/箸]、音写 pē guîo 无以对合，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 转动；转身、旋动
entries.en: to turn round; to rotate

entries.zh: 运动；行动、移动（自此处至彼处）
entries.en: to move about, from here to there; movement

entries.zh: 抽动；抽扯而动（牵抽使动）
entries.en: to move by tugging or pulling; to twitch
entries.notes: 中字『即』与音写 chiâ 于抽扯义对合不明（疑抄讹），据西文 'menear tirando'（抽扯而动）释义

entries.zh: 摇头示嘲；掉头弄姿以示轻侮
entries.en: to wag the head mockingly; to shake the head in derision
entries.notes: 汉字栏作差而标 [疑:搓]，音写 láu-thâu 未能对合于差/搓，据西文『摆头作嘲』释义
